title: Watermelon Zazu Totem
description: This resource pack adds... watermelon zazu
body:
Just a simple resourcepack, that adds a custom 3d model of the totem of undying, and also a custom sound pop for the totem
- Custom 3d totem
- Custom pop totem sound
